general.notes: Transmit power stated as >+1 dBm for C-band only; L-band transmit power not numerically specified. Reach: unamplified up to 75 km (800ZR) and 80 km (800G ZR+); amplified up to 120 km (800ZR) and over 1000 km (800G ZR+). Actual reach depends on fiber/connector loss and/or amplified line-system design. FOIC mode in 800G ZR+ only on transponders. Power consumption given as QSFP-DD type 2B compliant and OSFP power class 8 without wattage. Media interface is duplex LC. High transmit power and OSNR claimed qualitatively without numeric OSNR values.
